Central government employees to receive arrears, potentially up to ₹18 lakh

Central government employees are anticipating significant news regarding their arrears, with reports suggesting they could receive up to approximately ₹18 lakh. The 8th Pay Commission's report and its implementation are awaited. The commission has reportedly held multiple rounds of meetings with stakeholders in Jaipur, Chennai, Puducherry, and Chandigarh this month.
